body:
## Publication posture

Public semantic specification.

## Parent

Parent: #9.

## Objective

Define the **Rosetta-native epistemic/process semantics Bilqis must internalize before New Ithkuil language training**, expressed as compositions of the already-learned logic/mathematical primitives wherever possible.

Bilqis should learn the meaning beneath Rosetta, not JSON property names or tile boilerplate.

After this stage, Rosetta serialization should be mechanically compilable from semantic state rather than manually authored as cognitive content.

## Semantic target

Starting from the COGAL-05 genealogy, define machine-native pasigraphs/compositions for at least:

- Observation / observed signal
- Proposition
- Assertion / declaration
- Source
- Evidence
- Interpretation
- Conjecture + live alternatives
- Support / contradiction / insufficiency
- Evaluation + evaluator + criteria + evidence horizon + result
- Uncertainty / unknown / conflict / ambiguity
- Provenance / derivation
- Revision / supersession lineage
- Frame / role / context
- Policy / authority / scope / constraint
- Attestation / Receipt
- Episteme

Composite Rosetta objects such as Run, Action, Tapestry, Matrix, Delta Capsule and Incident SHOULD be decomposed into these primitives and only promoted into dedicated learned concepts when a developmental need justifies it.

## Mathematical description rule

Each Rosetta semantic object SHOULD be defined, where possible, only using:

- COGAL-02 logical identities/operators;
- COGAL-07 mathematical relation/set/function/graph primitives;
- already admitted semantic primitives.

If that basis cannot faithfully express a required Rosetta distinction, record a **semantic gap**. COGAL-05 may authorize a narrowly scoped New Ithkuil-derived semantic factor before the broader Ithkuil tranche. Do not smuggle English definitions into the substrate as the missing primitive.

## Serialization boundary

Define a deterministic mapping:

```
Bilqis-native semantic state
        ->
Rosetta semantic projection
        ->
conformant Rosetta v3 artifact(s)
```

The learner need not think in JSON or memorize tile envelopes.

Rosetta remains the durable external meaning/provenance/interoperability substrate. Bilqis learns semantics that can be compiled into Rosetta.

## Conformance fixtures

At minimum include non-linguistic fixtures proving that Bilqis can distinguish:

- `OBSERVED(P)` from `TRUE(P)`;
- `REPORTED_BY(S,P)` from `OBSERVED_BY(SELF,P)`;
- `CONJECTURE(P)` from `ASSERT(P)`;
- `EVALUATE(EVALUATOR,P,CRITERIA,...)` from `OBSERVE(P)`;
- `DERIVED_FROM(B,A)` from `PREV(B,A)`;
- `UNKNOWN` from `AMBIGUOUS` from `CONFLICT` from `FALSE`;
- authority/policy constraints from empirical propositions;
- provenance ancestry from semantic entailment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every admitted Rosetta epistemic primitive has a stable Bilqis semantic identity or an explicit composition.
- [ ] No primitive depends on an English lexical definition for executable meaning.
- [ ] Composite Rosetta artifacts decompose into the primitive algebra.
- [ ] Rosetta v3 serialization is deterministic from the admitted semantic projection.
- [ ] Serialization mechanics do not become cognitive primitives by accident.
- [ ] COGAL-05 semantic gaps are resolved, deferred or explicitly bridged with sourced New Ithkuil factors.
- [ ] Conformance fixtures prove the required non-collapse distinctions.
- [ ] Output is consumable by #7/#10/#11/#62/#17.

## Dependencies

COGAL-05, COGAL-07, #7.  
Rosetta v3.0.0 controls external semantic meaning.

## Downstream

COGAL-08, #82, #10.

## Workability

`EXECUTABLE_LEAF`: one bounded epistemic-algebra + serialization-boundary contract.
title: COGAL-06: Define the pre-language Rosetta epistemic algebra and deterministic serialization boundary
